name: typing-indicator
title: Typing Indicator
description: Bouncing dots that signal a reply is being composed, driven by staggered sine waves: a small continuous working-on-it motion that never resolves.
useWhen: Signalling that a reply or an answer is being composed, inside a message bubble or any container.
You need a small continuous working-on-it motion that never resolves, tinted through its colour.
You are timing the typing beat yourself instead of letting a flow block schedule it.
avoidWhen: The wait is an async operation rather than a conversation: use spinner, or skeleton when the placeholder resolves to content.
The dots should appear and disappear on a scripted conversation timeline: chat-flow already sequences them.
You want a caret blinking at the end of typed text: use caret.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Diameter of each dot in design pixels.

variables.label: Gap
variables.description: Space between dots in design pixels.

variables.label: Dot color
variables.description: Colour of the dots. Empty uses the theme's muted foreground.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.
